description: The meeting-detected popup window (Stage 5 Task 2) — deliberately the narrowest capability in the app: only the two commands it actually calls (popup_start/popup_dismiss) plus core:event (it listens for meeting-popup-payload via @tauri-apps/api/event, nothing else — no filesystem, window management, or any other app command). Everything else (delete_note, set_settings, start_recording, ...) is unreachable from this window.
